name: Site Reliability Engineering Practice
description: This practice implements the principles of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) as pioneered by Google and evolved by the industry. It focuses on balancing service reliability with the pace of innovation through Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Error Budgets, and the systematic elimination of toil.

alphas.name: Service Reliability
alphas.description: The degree to which a platform asset or service performs its intended function under specified conditions for a specified period.

states.name: Defined
states.description: Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Objectives (SLOs) are documented for the service.

checklist.name: Critical user journeys identified
checklist.description: High-level tasks users perform are mapped.

checklist.name: Relevant SLIs selected
checklist.description: Latency, availability, errors, or saturation metrics chosen.

checklist.name: Target SLOs proposed
checklist.description: Target percentages established for each SLI.

checklist.name: Stakeholder sign-off achieved
checklist.description: Business and engineering agree on the reliability targets.

states.name: Instrumented
states.description: The service is capable of emitting the necessary telemetry to measure the defined SLIs.

checklist.name: Metrics collection active
checklist.description: Exporter or agent is sending telemetry to the monitoring system.

checklist.name: Data pipelines verified
checklist.description: The metrics reaching the database are accurate and timely.

checklist.name: SLO calculation logic codified
checklist.description: The formula for the SLO (good events / total events) is implemented in tools.

states.name: Observable
states.description: The current state of reliability is visible and actionable alerting is in place.

checklist.name: Real-time dashboards published
checklist.description: Current SLO status and Error Budget burn rate are visible.

checklist.name: Alerting thresholds configured
checklist.description: Alerts trigger based on significant budget burn, not just threshold spikes.

checklist.name: Notification channels established
checklist.description: On-call engineers receive alerts via integrated paging systems.

states.name: Managed
states.description: The Error Budget is used to make data-driven decisions about feature velocity vs. reliability work.

checklist.name: Error budget policy defined
checklist.description: Consequences for budget exhaustion (e.g., feature freeze) are agreed upon.

checklist.name: Budget burn reviewed weekly
checklist.description: Team analyzes why the budget was consumed and identifies trends.

checklist.name: Reliability backlog prioritized
checklist.description: Engineering effort is diverted to reliability when budget is thin.

states.name: Reliable
states.description: The service consistently meets or exceeds its SLOs and the team has sufficient capacity for innovation.

checklist.name: SLOs met over the rolling window
checklist.description: Success rate stays within targets for the last 28 days.

checklist.name: Toil is under 50% of workload
checklist.description: Operational manual work does not dominate engineering time.

checklist.name: Resiliency tested in production
checklist.description: Chaos experiments confirm the system's fault tolerance.

workProducts.name: SLO Specification
workProducts.description: A document defining the Service Level Indicators and their corresponding Objectives.

levelsOfDetail.name: Drafted
levelsOfDetail.description: Initial set of SLIs and proposed targets recorded.

checklist.name: User journeys mapped to SLIs
checklist.description: Visual or list-based mapping exists.

checklist.name: Thresholds specified
checklist.description: Numerical targets provided.

levelsOfDetail.name: Approved
levelsOfDetail.description: Formal agreement from product and engineering stakeholders.

checklist.name: Error budget consequences signed
checklist.description: Agreed-upon policy for budget exhaustion.

checklist.name: Review schedule established
checklist.description: Plan for iterating on the SLO as the service evolves.

workProducts.name: Blameless Postmortem
workProducts.description: A report detailing an incident, its causes, and actions to prevent recurrence without assigning blame to individuals.

levelsOfDetail.name: Contextualized
levelsOfDetail.description: Timeline and impact are clearly documented.

checklist.name: Sequence of events recorded
checklist.description: Minute-by-minute log of what happened.

checklist.name: Impact quantified
checklist.description: How many users were affected and for how long.

levelsOfDetail.name: Remediated
levelsOfDetail.description: Action items are created and tracked to closure.

checklist.name: Root causes (Five Whys) identified
checklist.description: The systemic failure points are found.

checklist.name: Preventative tasks scheduled
checklist.description: Tickets created in the engineering backlog.

activities.name: Define SLOs and SLIs
activities.description: The process of identifying what matters most to the users and quantifying it as a measurable target.

activities.name: Conduct Incident Response
activities.description: Managing the lifecycle of a production failure from detection to mitigation.

activities.name: Perform Blameless Postmortem Analysis
activities.description: Reviewing an incident to learn and improve system resilience.

activities.name: Eliminate Toil via Automation
activities.description: The systematic replacement of manual, repetitive tasks with automated software solutions.

workBreakdowns.name: SRE Foundation Setup
workBreakdowns.description: Core tasks to establish SRE practices on a new platform service.

complexity.name: SRE Complexity Profile
complexity.description: Evaluates the difficulty of instrumenting the target service.

task.name: Identify Critical User Journeys
task.description: Meet with Product Owners to determine the 3-5 most important things a user does.

task.name: Implement Telemetry Exporters
task.description: Modify service configuration or code to export metrics in a format like Prometheus.

task.name: Create SLO Dashboards
task.description: Build visualizations in Grafana or similar tool to track error budget burn.

task.name: Configure Multi-Window Multi-Burnrate Alerts
task.description: Set up sophisticated alerting to catch both fast and slow budget burns.
